name: archer push up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands wider than shoulder-width. Lower your body to one side, bending one elbow while keeping the other arm straight. Push back up to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: assisted chest dip (kneeling)
instructions: Use an assisted dip machine. Kneel on the platform and grasp the handles. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up to the starting position.

name: assisted seated pectoralis major stretch with stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground. Lean back and open your arms wide, letting the stability ball support your upper back and stretch your chest.

name: assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling)
instructions: Use an assisted dip machine. Kneel on the platform and grasp the handles with a wide grip. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up to the starting position.

name: band bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with a resistance band under your back. Grasp the band with both hands and press it up towards the ceiling, then lower it back down and repeat.

name: band one arm twisting chest press
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the band with one hand. Press the band forward while twisting your torso, then return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a shoulder-width grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell decline bench press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Grasp a barbell with a shoulder-width grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell decline pullover
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Hold a barbell above your chest with straight arms. Lower the barbell over your head while keeping your arms straight, then pull it back to the starting position.

name: barbell decline wide-grip press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Grasp a barbell with a wide grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell front raise and pullover
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with straight arms in front of your thighs. Raise the barbell overhead, then lower it behind your head and return to the starting position.

name: barbell guillotine bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a wide grip and lower it to your neck. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell incline bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a shoulder-width grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell incline shoulder raise
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet flat on the ground. Hold a barbell above your chest with straight arms. Raise your shoulders towards your ears, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell reverse grip decline bench press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Grasp a barbell with a reverse grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell reverse grip incline bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a reverse grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell wide bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a wide grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the ground. Grasp a barbell with a wide reverse grip and lower it to your chest. Press the barbell back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: behind head chest stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Reach your arms behind your head and clasp your hands together. Pull your arms back to stretch your chest and hold the position.

name: cable bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with a cable machine on either side. Grasp the handles and press them up towards the ceiling, then lower them back down and repeat.
